## Description

An assembly that the producer modelled with four logical NAUO instances of the same bolt PRODUCT (slot_1..slot_4), all at the same XYZ coordinate at export time (downstream rules would later move each to its slot). The export pipeline deduplicated by transform-equality, emitting a single NAUO. The kernel reports one child instance; downstream BOM, kinematics, and sub-assembly counts expect four. Receivers see one bolt where four were intended.

## Reproducer recipe

PRODUCT chain with assembly + child bolt. ONE NAUO entity referencing the bolt PRODUCT. The producer's intent documented via the NAUO's name/description fields ("expected_4_collapsed_to_1").

## Expected kernel behavior

Surface the count of NAUO instances per parent-child pair so downstream BOM tools can detect collapsed counts by comparing against drawing-of-record expectations. A kernel should not silently dedupe NAUO instances.
